title: 🛰️ GPU cluster observability and utilization
text: Here is the result of "fetch" for the Page with URL https://app.notion.com/p/41b4a78a1c87810f8533dda3777fba9f as of 2026-11-19T22:19:23.103Z: {"Category":"ops","Last edited":"2026-11-19T22:19:23.103Z","Name":"GPU cluster observability and utilization","Status":"In progress","date:Period:is_datetime":0,"date:Period:start":"2026-11-17","url":"https://app.notion.com/p/41b4a78a1c87810f8533dda3777fba9f"} {"type":"emoji","emoji":"🛰️"} # Plan Next PRs, in order; none started. - vLLM 0.34 + FlashInfer 0.7.3: benchmark on one B200. - B200 node pools: upgrade 1.35.5 → 1.35.8 on use1, uss1, usw1 together. - Terraform; Jean applies. - usw3: review static ScaledObjects and node-local cache. # Logs ✅ = merged. 🟡 = open, waiting on Jean's review. - Rollouts and config - [#15158](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/15158) ✅ + Deploy — one main SHA across all Flux rollout cluster jobs. - [#15153](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/15153) ✅ — EFA device plugin opt-in, off on prod-gpu-usw1. - Terraform apply pending (Jean). - [#15151](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/15151) ✅ — cleanupOnFail false on all GPU clusters. - Deploys with the next Flux promote. - [#15156](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/15156) 🟡 — rollout-freeze-reaper retries Kubernetes API calls on HTTP 429. - [#15259](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/15259) ✅ — B200 sharing: guarantee each model's minimum, share the rest (use1/uss1: 16/4/3 + 9 shared off-peak, 16/7/3 + 6 weekdays; usw3 unchanged). Floor-priority baseline graphs + shared -burst graphs. CI green. - Stamped plan: B200 GPU sharing: guarantee each model's minimum, share the rest - [#15374](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/15374) ✅ — snapshot checkpoint completion grace 30m → 60m on use1, uss1, usw3. Opened ; CI green, Codex and Devin Review clean. - fpp-35b Filestore writes took 30m35s and 40m37s on uss1, failing the Nov 18 promote at the canary. - Merged ; deploys with the next Flux promote. - [#15380](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/15380) ✅ — Flux rollback never restores the pin it replaced; GKE wait is a wait_minutes input (default 90, max 300). Opened , merged . - Workflow change, live on merge; no cluster deploy needed. - The Nov 18 uss1 rollback to 3117ac9 timed out at 90m and its failure handler re-pinned fbb93d4 ([run](https://github.com/reductoai/api/actions/runs/44460762567)). - [#15398](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/15398) ✅ — a burst graph can restore from its baseline graph's checkpoint (worker.checkpoint.burstReuse, off by default), so a model is captured once. Opened , merged . - No deploy needed: manifests are unchanged until a cluster sets the value. - Trial: [#15409](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/15409) ✅ + Deploy — reuse on for fpp-35b on uss1 only. Opened ; CI green. - Deployed with the 6349ee1 promote ([run](https://github.com/reductoai/api/actions/runs/44591277834)), all four clusters, . - Result on uss1: burst pods restore from the baseline's checkpoint in 1.6 to 1.7 min (cold 4.7 to 6.2 min; the burst graph's own capture took 19 min and is gone). - Router traffic sent to Modal for fpp-35b: 0.7 to 0.8% after, 2.4 to 3.4% before (20 min window, not proven to be the trial). - [#15415](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/15415) ✅ + Deploy failed on uss1 — turn off Dynamo NATS on all GPU clusters (global.nats.install: false). Stamped by Jean. Opened . - NATS carries no traffic (TCP requests, ZMQ events), but new pods fail to start without it. - Merge after today's promote and the uss1 reuse trial: every frontend and worker rolls once, and checkpoints are recaptured. - Rollout : usw1 ok. On uss1 the gate restored 6349ee after an old-template burst worker (still with NATS\_SERVER) hit CrashLoopBackOff. use1 and usw3 not touched. Two-step follow-up [#15453](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/15453) 🟡, stamped by Jean: step 1 stops injecting NATS\_SERVER and keeps NATS up; step 2 removes NATS once every pod has rolled. Merge with a merge commit and roll one commit at a time. - Logs to Datadog - [#15150](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/15150) 🟡 — ship snapshot and flux-system logs on GPU clusters. - Monitors - [#15149](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/15149) ✅ — pod restarts and CrashLoopBackOff. - Datadog Terraform apply pending (Jean). - [#15152](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/15152) ✅ — checkpoint-prune job failures. - Datadog Terraform apply pending (Jean). - [#15154](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/15154) 🟡 — Modal cold-start regression (snapshot restore vs plain). - [#15155](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/15155) 🟡 — DGD readiness and Triton ready pods. - Needs cluster-observability applied first. - [#15160](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/15160) 🟡 — Flux drift on prod GPU clusters. - [#15166](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/15166) 🟡 — stuck model downloads and slow model loads. - Simplified: direct pre-commit copy and inlined pod identity; 41 lines removed. 115 targeted tests and all 35 CI checks pass; fresh review has no findings. Not merged or deployed. [Written by Devin](https://app.devin.ai/sessions/6b9e528e051548f2bb9e9e6829b51bb3) - [#15161](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/15161) ✅ — fix stuck and stale GPU monitors. - Datadog Terraform apply pending (Jean). - Delete MLE p95 monitors 25548843 and 25548845 in Datadog (Jean). - [#15168](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/15168) 🟡 — tag FPP shadow replay and autoeval judge calls so they leave the prod failed-calls alert. - [#15304](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/15304) ✅ — terminal-throughput monitor 27401592 imported to Terraform with a 20-job volume floor (stops prod\_au low-traffic false alerts). - Datadog Terraform apply pending (Jean). - Daily release scan — - Done, read-only: Triton 26.11 / 2.75 ships [core #533](https://github.com/triton-inference-server/core/pull/533), a dynamic-batcher use-after-free fix whose vulnerable sequence exists in our 26.05 / 2.69 source. Proposed for Xavier: evaluate a core-only backport on one offline H200; no full CUDA/TensorRT upgrade and no demonstrated production incident. - Confirmed observability gap: a live FPP-2B worker exports three aggregate speculative-decoding counters that the chart blocks; Datadog US3 has no acceptance metrics or monitors. Proposed: collect those three counters, baseline 24 hours, then add a load-gated acceptance-regression warning. - Yesterday's vLLM/FlashInfer trial was not repeated. Both new proposals await approval; no PRs, image builds, benchmarks, monitor changes, or rollouts. - Triton router fallbacks — - [#15355](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/15355) ✅ — tag reducto.triton\_[flash.live](http://flash.live)\_fallbacks with the error behind each router fallback (RouterUnavailable reason or exception type). CI green; Devin Review and Codex clean. - Router and usw1 logs don't show why table\_ensemble falls back (\~21% of calls vs 0.02% for ordering\_model); the tag confirms the cause. - Split-pool deadline fix dropped (Xavier): the table\_ensemble spike was the live\_fallbacks cumulative counter bug, fixed in [#15392](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/15392). [Written by Devin](https://app.devin.ai/sessions/d3cac10495e344d4852c3c1d7abab943) ## Impact Baseline, measured . Each day ends 16:00 PT; Nov 14–15 is the weekend dip. Datadog US3 + Modal billing. - usw1 qwen RF-DETR at 5 seats vs 6, 24 h: p99 1.33 s, under the 1.5 s line in all 8 windows; same throughput as 6 seats; Modal share 26% vs 15% with demand +10%. Measured on usw1, 24 h to 2026-11-19 11:47 PT. - GPU cost per 1k pages: \$1.56 (Nov 18), \$1.87 (Nov 17), \$2.24 (Nov 16); \$5.73–\$6.96 on the weekend. - Self-hosted fleet \$17.4K/day (96 B200 × \$7.09/GPU-h + 8 H200 × \$5.72) + Modal prod, over prod pages (22.5M on Nov 18). - Modal prod spend: \$13.4K, \$8.4K, \$7.3K, \$11.6K, \$13.0K, \$17.7K per day (Nov 13 → 18). - Nov 18 jump is fpp-flash \$6.3K (vs \$1.4K) during the FPP-2B fallback spike. - GPU utilization (avg DCGM), Nov 18: use1 26%, uss1 27%, usw3 28%, usw1 23%; 5–11% on the weekend. - p99 per model call, Nov 18: FPP-35B 3.5 s (9.0 s on Nov 13), FPP-2B 5.0 s. - Fallbacks, Nov 18: FPP-2B 6.94M (30K–220K/day before), FPP-35B 34K, Triton router live fallbacks 81K (1.29M on Nov 13). - After: updated as each PR's effect shows; B200 sharing after tonight's 19:00 PT promote.
